desc: Audit LLM provider abstraction: check for tight coupling and strategy pattern compliance
context: Read all files in app/llms/**. Assess whether the code uses abstract base classes or strategy patterns to allow swapping between LLM providers (OpenAI, Azure, AWS Bedrock, Google AI, Ollama). Note any direct provider SDK imports in business logic (should be isolated in adapters). Note the LiteLLM migration status - aws_chat.py and clients.py appear related.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 llms/ files read and assessed
Provider coupling violations documented with file:line evidence
LiteLLM migration status assessed (is it complete/in-progress/abandoned?)
